Done. The plan is at `operations/engineering/fars/docs/vps-model-infrastructure-plan.md`.

Key findings:

**The big surprise is Hetzner pricing.** A 4-core/8GB VPS costs EUR 6.80/mo ($7.50) — less than your current Vultr 1-core/1.6GB at $12/mo. Migration alone saves money while gaining 5x the RAM and 4x the CPU.

**What runs where:**
- **Hetzner CX22 ($4.15/mo)**: Qwen2.5-0.5B at ~15-20 tok/s — good for classification, routing
- **Hetzner CX32 ($7.50/mo)**: Qwen2.5-1.5B at ~10-18 tok/s — the sweet spot for agentic tasks (hook eval, extraction, dispatch routing)
- **Vast.ai RTX 3090 ($0.09-0.13/hr)**: QLoRA fine-tuning. A full training run costs **under $0.30**

**Architecture**: Always-on cheap VPS for inference + GPU spot instances on-demand for fine-tuning. No GPU VPS needed permanently.

**Monthly cost**: Current ~$30-60 (Vultr + API) drops to ~$19-29 (Hetzner + occasional Vast.ai + reduced API for hard tasks only).
